descripcion: At C2 a story can withhold, misdirect and then resolve deliberately — controlling exactly what the listener knows at each point, not merely presenting events in an engaging order. This is narrative craft, close to literary technique, applied to a true account.

filas: leads the listener to a wrong but plausible conclusion
the payoff lands after the tension has built

ejemplos.texto: At the time, I assumed it was a coincidence. It wasn't.
Everyone in the room thought the same thing — everyone except, it turned out, the one person who mattered.
I only found out the real reason years later.

notas: It wasn't, placed alone after a false assumption, is a compact way to signal that a reversal is coming without spelling it out yet.
Misdirection works by stating what everyone believed, including the narrator, before revealing it was wrong — the narrator's own past ignorance becomes part of the technique.
Delaying the resolution (I only found out years later) is a controlled way to hold tension across a longer narrative.

contraste.es: El español narrativo culto usa técnicas de suspenso muy similares, así que el concepto no es nuevo. La dificultad para un hispanohablante de C2 suele estar en el ritmo: el inglés narrativo tiende a usar oraciones más cortas y cortantes en el momento del giro (It wasn't.), mientras que el español a menudo mantiene una prosa más fluida incluso en el clímax.

errores: Revealing the twist too early, which undercuts the built tension.
Using long, flowing sentences at the moment of reversal instead of a short, cutting one.
Overusing misdirection until the story feels manipulative rather than crafted.
autochequeo: Is a key fact deliberately withheld, not just omitted by accident?
Does the reversal land with a short, cutting sentence rather than a long one?
Is the misdirection genuinely plausible, not obviously false?
Would a listener feel the craft, not manipulation?
Would a listener feel satisfied, not tricked, by the resolution?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on narrative control: withholding, misdirection, delayed resolution. Check the rhythm of the sentence at the moment of reversal. Do not rewrite the text.
